sourceEvidenceContract.caseSelectorPolicy: A ;case= selector must exactly equal the caseSelector retained by every contributing fragment. Method-level TRX success alone is inadmissible. Multiple observations for one selector are aggregated only when assertion and measurement schemas are deeply equal, with an explicit observation-count measurement.
sourceEvidenceContract.sourceEvidenceProjectionPolicy: sourceEvidenceByteLength and sourceEvidenceSha256 bind the exact bytes at sourceEvidenceRelativePath; parsing those bytes as schema-v1 JSON must produce an entries array deeply equal to bundle entries.
sourceEvidenceContract.trialResultsPolicy: trialResults is required and contains exact objects with id, relativePath, byteLength, and sha256. Standard methods bind one method result at trial-results/method.trx. CameraAgent acceptance binds exactly trial-1 through trial-5 at trial-results/trial-1.trx through trial-results/trial-5.trx; result.trx remains the canonical sanitized TRX and is byte-identical to trial-1.trx.
sourceEvidenceContract.testAssemblyProvenancePolicy: Standard source-family commands rebuild with NoIncremental=true and a deterministic relative PathMap from the clean reviewed evidence harness. The harness must be a descendant of the pinned product revision and every changed path must be allowlisted test, evidence-import, contract, or documentation support. testAssemblyBuildRevision and testAssemblyBuildTree must equal evidenceHarnessRevision/evidenceHarnessTree, testAssemblySha256 binds the rebuilt bytes at testAssemblyRelativePath, and retained assemblies must not contain the canonical repository path. Scenario entries remain bound to the pinned product revision/tree. The issue-211 harness independently builds with the same PathMap after capturing and continuously checking the same clean worktree fingerprint.
sourceEvidenceContract.acceptanceInputPolicy: The source-import index binds the reviewed digest-qualified collector image plus the installed production catalog manifest SHA-256, database SHA-256, and database byte length. The CameraAgent acceptance bundle repeats that exact object; non-acceptance bundles use null.

revisionBindings.expected: clean reviewed execution HEAD descended from requiredSourceRevision

redactionPolicy.validation: Reject recursively matched prohibited field names, control characters, absolute paths, URI authorities, and values matching registered secret fingerprints before hashing or publication.

rules: Every requested scenario appears exactly once.
Every entry source revision and tree equal the requested campaign revision and tree.
Every assertion is explicit and passed; loop execution inferred from method success is rejected.
Every bundle relative path is safe and identifies the exact external bytes bound by its declared length when present and SHA-256; no digest binds its containing bundle.
TRX, every trialResults file, and source evidence are immutable, length-bound, SHA-256-bound, sanitized inputs.

The importer owns clean nonincremental builds, exact-FQN execution, immediate TRX sanitization, assembly capture, and provenance generation; operator-assembled retained inputs are not a production interface.

The committed source-import index binds every method source bundle by relative path, byte length, and SHA-256, and each method bundle binds its assembly, every sanitized trial result, canonical sanitized TRX, and source-evidence bytes.

evidenceRecord.revision: Baseline/candidate revision, branch, source tree, and clean-state disposition are required.
Baseline/candidate revision, branch, source tree, and clean-state disposition are required.

campaignIndexContract.latestPointerPolicy: The pointer is the only replaceable file. It is published last and binds publicationGeneration plus the generation-scoped index and commit relative paths and SHA-256 values. Every referenced generation remains immutable.
campaignIndexContract.sourceRevisionPolicy: Each scenario independently binds the revision/tree that produced its evidence. source-family-import rows must equal sourceEvidenceContract.requiredSourceRevision/requiredSourceTree. real-campaign rows bind the clean execution revision/tree selected and retained by issue 320 after its harness is reviewed. Deferred and excluded rows have no artifact source revision. acceptanceRevision and acceptanceTree identify aggregator code separately.

revisionBindings.expected: corresponding runtime artifact sourceRevision/sourceTree retained by issue 320

campaignIndexContract.resumePolicy: A committed generation is immutable. Resume validates the owner-only commit envelope against the canonical index byte length and SHA-256, then validates every artifact length/digest before publishing generation plus one.
campaignIndexContract.completionPolicy: campaign-complete requires every source-family-import and real-campaign row passed; deferred and excluded rows remain separately counted and are never reported as executed.
